name: wcol
description: Columnar storage and query runtime for the browser and native — Parquet-class compression, tiny Wasm decode, DuckDB-style analytics

scripts.build:stream-wasm: cd rust && RUSTFLAGS='-C panic=abort -C target-feature=+simd128 --cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' cargo build -p wcol --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --config 'profile.release.strip="debuginfo"' && cd .. && wasm-opt -O3 --strip-debug --strip-producers rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wcol.wasm -o rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wcol.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:browser
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/ts-host-boundary.test.ts tests/stream-pool-echo.test.ts tests/stream-pool-scale.test.ts tests/session-fence.test.ts tests/reducer-spill-memory.test.ts tests/reducer-spill-plateau.test.ts tests/reducer-spill-lifecycle.test.ts tests/sqlite-spill-port.test.ts tests/coordinator-tasks.test.ts tests/iterative-exec.test.ts tests/bounded-byte-pipe.test.ts tests/r2-multipart-write-port.test.ts tests/execution-graph.test.ts tests/scan-edge-session.test.ts tests/plan-dispatch.test.ts tests/graph-job-boundaries.test.ts tests/router.test.ts tests/reducer-unattached-ports.test.ts tests/egress-memory-plateau.test.ts tests/direct-rpc-engine.test.ts tests/job-replay.test.ts tests/r2-conditional.test.ts tests/node-session.test.ts tests/cloudflare-lifecycle.test.ts tests/clickbench-local.test.ts tests/isolate-load.test.ts tests/spill-run-prefetch.test.ts tests/spill-run-uploads.test.ts tests/finalizer-input-guard.test.ts tests/port-budget.test.ts tests/native-reducer.test.ts tests/reducer-choice.test.ts tests/live-job-view.test.ts tests/live-findings.test.ts
scripts.test:spill-rust: cd rust && cargo test -p wcol --test spill_groups -- --test-threads=4
scripts.test:spill-rust-stress: cd rust && cargo test -p wcol --test spill_groups_stress -- --ignored
scripts.test:spill-lifecycle-scale: npm run build:node-wasm && npx tsx --test tests/reducer-spill-lifecycle.test.ts
scripts.test:spill-cf-signature: npm run build:node-wasm && npx tsx --test tests/reducer-spill-cf-signature.test.ts
scripts.test:spill-do-focused: npm run build:node-wasm && npx tsx --test tests/reducer-spill-do-focused.test.ts
scripts.test:spill-do-focused:mf: npm run build:node-wasm && npm run build:coordinator-wasm && npm run build:workers && SPILL_DO_MINIFLARE=1 npx tsx --test tests/reducer-spill-do-focused.test.ts
scripts.test:iterative-miniflare: npm run build:node-wasm && npm run build:coordinator-wasm && tsx --test tests/iterative-miniflare.test.ts
scripts.test:spill-metrics-scope: npm run build:node-wasm && npx tsx --test tests/spill-metrics-scope.test.ts
scripts.test:spill-fanin: npm run build:node-wasm && npx tsx --test tests/reducer-spill-fanin.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'fan-in experiment'
scripts.test:spill-fanin-full: npm run build:node-wasm && SPILL_FANIN_ONLY=FULL SPILL_FANIN_STRICT=1 npx tsx --test tests/reducer-spill-fanin.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'CF-shaped single run'
scripts.spill-fanin-full-run: npm run build:node-wasm && npx tsx scripts/spill-fanin-full.mts
scripts.test:spill-fanin-probe: npm run build:node-wasm && npx tsx --test tests/spill-fanin-probe.test.ts
scripts.test:spill-cf: npm run build:node-wasm && npm run build:coordinator-wasm && npm run build:workers && npm run test:cf-spill-quick
scripts.df-planner:dev: npm run df-planner:build-wasm && wrangler dev --config cloudflare/df-planner/wrangler.toml --port 8799
scripts.celld:dev: npm run celld:prepare && env CELLD_ESBUILD="$PWD/node_modules/.bin/esbuild" CELLD_OPERATION_DEADLINE_MS="${CELLD_OPERATION_DEADLINE_MS:-120000}" celld dev cloudflare/celld/wrangler.jsonc --logs
